premises.text: Frequent cattle weighing is critical for health, genetics, sale timing, and value but traditional weighing is laborious, stressful, injurious, and causes weight loss
premises.evidence_span: obtaining weight information is labor-intensive, time-consuming, and expensive, so it's rarely obtained

premises.text: Portable 3D-camera software estimates cattle weight automatically as animals pass, stress-free and much faster than traditional weighing
premises.evidence_span: Our proprietary software uses a portable 3D camera to estimate the weight of the cattle

premises.text: A dashboard gives recommendations to optimize weight gain and profitability across individuals and groups
premises.evidence_span: farmers can see our dashboard with recommendations on how to optimize weight gain and profitability

premises.text: Portable camera plus per-animal-month pricing is cheaper and more scalable than passage scales or manual photo apps for all farm sizes
premises.evidence_span: Olho do Dono is portable. The 3D camera costs around R$ 3,000 and we charge R$ 1 per animal month

premises.text: Platform recommendations on products that optimize weight gain earn commission fees
premises.evidence_span: Our platform also gives recommendations on products that can optimize weight gain and we make a commission fee on that

premises.text: Initial market is Brazil's large herd with later expansion to Latin America, EU, US, Australia, and others
premises.evidence_span: The Brazilian initial market for Olho do Dono is at 1.2 billion reais yearly

value.text: Higher beef-cattle productivity and profitability while maintaining cow well-being
value.evidence_span: increase the beef cattle productivity and profitability while maintaining the well-being of the cow

causal_links.evidence_span: We help farmers to grow their bottom lines

notes: Health/genetics/sale timing pains folded into one weighing problem premise (§4.1.6). Camera+auto ID+speed treated as one mechanism; dashboard recommendations kept as related analytics path. Traction betas and team bios excluded. Price amount kept with commercial packaging (§4.1.3).
